mapper.sql: id, title, type, current_value AS currentValue, total_value AS totalValue, achieved, achieved_day AS achievedDay, due_day AS dueDay
mapper.select: SELECT FROM weekly_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_goal (user_id, title, type, current_value, total_value, achieved, achieved_day, due_day) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{currentValue}, #{totalValue}, 0, NULL, #{dueDay})
